source_acquisition.search_note: 现有 visual_source_inventory.csv 将该 paper 标为 no_public_source_found，并只列 microsoft/protein-sequence-models；本地 corpus/visual_sources 没有目标目录。gh 复核到标题精确匹配的 BorgwardtLab/TEDBench（main），README 与 paper/data/model 对应，但完整 Git tree 仅有 resources/tedbench_logo*.png 等 logo，没有 Figure/Table plot source、.tex/.svg/.ipynb 或 plotting/table-generator 文件，仓库内 matplotlib、seaborn、Figure、t-SNE、plot 搜索也无命中。因此仓库可作方法/数据背景，不能作 exact visual source。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 统计图以蓝/红或绿/蓝表达 protocol/metric；结构图以红色 ribbon 和灰色 mask 表达可见/重建状态；Figure 7 用蓝–紫–红 attention heatmap，Figure 1/8 使用多色 CATH 分类。颜色常有语义，但并非所有对象都有形状/纹理替代编码。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 整体 mixed：正文文字、表格、Figure 3、Figure 4–6/8 的线条和点主要为 vector；Figure 1/2/7/9 含嵌入 raster protein renderings，Figure 1 还混合 raster 与 vector 模块。
paper_style.style_consistency: 双栏 Letter proceedings、italic/bold caption 标题、少量横线表格和低饱和统计色形成主系统；结构 raster 的 red/gray 与 t-SNE 多色 palette 视觉差异较大，Figure 7 panel caption 错位、Table 4/9 继承语义和 Figure 8 缺 legend 是局部不一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Overview of the TEDBench. TEDBench is a large-scale, non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification. Given the high diversity of protein structures, CATH (Orengo et al., 1997) provides a hierarchical classification of protein domain structures. TED (Lau et al., 2024) extends this to AFDB. Our TEDBench builds upon TED and contains more than 460K predicted structures and 27K experimental structures as an external test set. Classifying protein structures offers important biological insights into their functions.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3. Overview of the MiAE architecture. During pre-training, a high masking ratio (e.g., 90%) is applied to backbone frames. The geometric encoder processes only this small subset of unmasked frames, maintaining SE(3)-invariance relative to the input coordinates. Following the encoder, mask tokens are reintegrated into the latent sequence. A lightweight decoder then operates on the full set of encoded frames and mask tokens to reconstruct the original backbone coordinates. After pre-training, the decoder is discarded, and the encoder is applied to uncorrupted backbone coordinates for downstream tasks.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5. MiAE ablation experiments with linear probing on TEDBench. We report both accuracy (acc) and macro F1 score (F1). If not specified, the default setting (marked in gray) is MiAE-B with a decoder of depth 2 and width 512, the reconstruction loss is the composite loss L_ESM3, including the inverse folding loss (invf), the masking strategy is random, and the masking ratio is 90%. (a) Decoder depth. A deep decoder can lead to gains for avg but not cls pool. (b) Decoder width. The decoder needs to be narrower than the encoder. (c) Model size. Larger models achieve better linear probing performance. (d) Reconstruction loss. Inverse folding loss is useful when added to the objective. (e) Masking strategy. Span masking is slightly better, but more complicated. (f) Sequence incorporation. Incorporating amino acid sequence is useful.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 benchmark map → Figure 3 MiAE pipeline → Table 1 denominators → Table 2/3 protocol comparisons → Table 4/5 component controls → Figure 4/5 trends → Figure 6 latent space → Appendix Figure 7/8/9 and Tables 6–9 reproducibility/coverage。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 多数 caption 采用斜体编号、bold 标题、setup/encoding/finding；Figure 1–3 较自足，Figure 4–6 短而偏 finding，Appendix Figure 7–9 偏条件和 visual key。Figure 7 panel mapping 冲突，Table 4/9 slash/空白继承语义和 Figure 8 后两 panel 无 legend 降低自足性。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1–3 使用 grouped headers 区分来源、protocol 与 test/external；Table 2/3 用 bold/underline 标 best/second-best，Table 5/9 用 gray row 标 default；Table 4/8 等小表采用单层 header 和 booktabs-like 横线。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 3/Appendix B.1–B.3 固定 method interface 与复现参数；Table 2/3 回收性能和 representation；Table 4/5、Figure 4/5 对应 masking、decoder、loss、scale、sequence 组件问题；Table 9 完整复列 ablation。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figure 2/4–6、Table 1–5 先给 benchmark、主比较、关键 trade-off 和定性 latent；Appendix Tables 6–9、Figures 7–9 承载架构/训练复现、cost、完整消融、attention 与 reconstruction coverage。附录补充样本和实现细节，但没有补上 seed uncertainty。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 主文和附录均以 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern serif 为主，图内统计轴和散点加入 DejaVu Sans/Times New Roman；字号层级总体一致，但小栏 raster、Figure 8 多 panel 和 Table 9 宽表在缩放后阅读成本更高。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: red/gray 结构语义在 Figures 2/9 一致，blue/red test-external 语义在 Figure 5 一致；Figure 1/8 CATH categorical palettes 与 Figure 7 attention sequential palette 各自合理但没有跨对象共享 legend，灰度安全性有限。

most_reusable_patterns: 用跨栏 benchmark overview 固定输入、标签层级、数据分母与独立测试来源。
用 matched pipeline 图说明训练期/下游期组件边界，再以带 protocol/规模语境的主表回收结果。
消融表用统一 default row、局部 subtitle 和同一指标组组织组件问题；趋势图同时画收益和代价。
将 t-SNE、attention 和 reconstruction 明确标为 qualitative companion，并与 quantitative evidence 分开。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：一次固定 benchmark 身份、标签层级、long-tail 和 external test。
Figure 3：表达 high masking、visible-only encoder、mask-token reintegration、lightweight decoder 与 discard。
Table 2：同表保留 protocol、参数规模、test/external acc/F1。
Table 3：隔离 frozen representation，并单列 >1B ESM2。
Table 5 + Figure 4：分别给 recipe map 与 masking performance/error trade-off。
failure_patterns: 所有结果表和 Figure 4/5 都没有跨 seed、误差范围或重复实验信息。
Figure 6/8 t-SNE 没有坐标语义/完整 legend/cluster metric；Figure 7 没有 colorbar 且 panel mapping 错误。
Table 4/9 slash 数值和空白继承依赖正文；Figure 5 caption 未写 dataset-size 单位。
公共 TEDBench 仓库没有 Figure/Table 视觉源，不能声称获得 exact visual source。

final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 先用 benchmark 与 MiAE pipeline 固定对象和机制，再用带参数/协议语境的主表与 targeted ablation 回收可判定结果，最后把没有统计不确定性的 latent、attention 和 reconstruction 作为明确限定的定性补充。
